title: Polynomial-Time Computability of a Block Slice
statement: Fix a nondeterministic finite Turing machine $N$ and natural numbers $d,c,A,a$. Let $o$ assign a natural number $o(y)$ to each Boolean word $y$, and suppose the function sending $y$ to a word of $o(y)$ true bits is polynomial-time computable. Then the function sending $y$ to the slice of the second component extracted from $y$, beginning at offset $o(y)$ and having length $A(|x|+1)^a$, is polynomial-time computable, where $x$ is the first component extracted from $y$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic finite Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
A function $o$ from Boolean words to natural numbers
Polynomial-time computability of $y\mapsto$ the word of $o(y)$ true bits
